Analysis code and reproducibility materials for a manuscript on leaf mechanical
properties under dehydration, using three-point bending and tensile tests.
Migrated from [paper-leaf-mechanics](https://github.com/maple60/paper-leaf-mechanics)
with its Git history retained.

## Current status

Private preparation for a future manuscript data/code release. The source
repository contains no measurement data, so complete reproduction has not been
verified. Manuscript citation, dataset DOI, and reuse licenses remain to be
confirmed. See [migration notes](docs/migration.md).

## Quickstart

Run all commands from the repository root.

1. Obtain the input files listed in [data/README.md](data/README.md).
2. Copy `.Renviron.example` to `.Renviron` and set `PROJECT_DATA_DIR` to the
   directory containing `raw/` and `manual/`. Use forward slashes on Windows.
   Restart R after editing `.Renviron`. The default input directory is `data/`.
3. Restore the original dependency versions in R:

   ```r
   renv::restore()
   ```

4. Integrate the data, then generate summaries and manuscript figures:

   ```sh
   Rscript scripts/01_data_integration.R
   Rscript scripts/02_spp_summary.R
   Rscript scripts/03_fig_1.R
   Rscript scripts/04_fig_2.R
   Rscript scripts/05_fig_3.R
   quarto render scripts/07_fig_S3.qmd --to html
   ```

Numbering is inherited; no script numbered 06 was present. Each step reads
inputs independently after integration.

## Requirements

- R: the source `renv.lock` records R 4.5.1; migration syntax checks use R 4.5.3.
- Existing dependencies are recorded in `renv.lock`, including `mgcv` for
  generalized additive models. Figures use base R graphics.
- Quarto for the Figure S3 notebook and README rendering.
- Python and DVC are not required by the migrated analysis.

## Data and outputs

Original exports and manually entered metadata live outside Git.
`PROJECT_DATA_DIR` can point to an external directory such as a Dropbox folder.
The actual input files must be present; an empty folder is insufficient.
See [data requirements](data/README.md) for filenames, encodings, and schema
constraints.

Generated CSV files go to `outputs/tables/`; SVG figures go to
`outputs/figures/`. Outputs are ignored by Git and do not overwrite input data.

## Repository layout

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `scripts/01_data_integration.R` | Import exports, merge metadata, apply existing exclusions. |
| `scripts/02_spp_summary.R` | Species summaries for thickness, LDMC, and LMA. |
| `scripts/03_fig_1.R` through `05_fig_3.R` | Main manuscript figures. |
| `scripts/07_fig_S3.qmd` | Supplementary comparison of EI decrease at 80% RWC. |

| `renv.lock`, `renv/` | Inherited dependency versions and bootstrap. |
| `docs/migration.md` | Source commit, migration details, and release checklist. |

## Verification and limitations

Migration checks cover R script and Quarto chunk syntax, input/output
references, the inherited lockfile, and Git whitespace. Missing raw inputs cause
an explicit error. Actual integration, GAM fits, and manuscript figure
equivalence require the missing dataset and have not yet been verified.

Original metadata column order and exclusions are retained. Review them against
the manuscript before public release, particularly the existing application of
the bending exclusion table to tensile records.
